nodes.label: Cifra clave: the pull-figure
nodes.rationale: Must be the STORY'S OWN figure: calibrated 2026-08-05 when a LIV Golf piece led with the PIF's historical context figure and the homepage surfaced the wrong number. The homepage's 'La cifra del dia' prefers a declared Cifra clave over anything scraped from title/excerpt, and the caption has to name the thing because the rail prints it away from the article.

nodes.label: The dynamic element library (thirteen devices)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth is code, not this file: if a limit here disagrees with lib/article-devices.ts, the code wins and this file is stale.

nodes.label: Cronologia: the drawn timeline
nodes.rationale: The 6-item ceiling is a hard code limit: parseTimeline returns null past 6 and the whole paragraph renders inert. When a saga runs past 6, pick the spine and weave the rest into prose.

nodes.label: Duelo: the butterfly chart
nodes.rationale: One scale for the whole device (publisher directive 2026-08-08) so rows read against each other; a percentage row next to money rows silently drops it back to per-row scaling. Check both numerators cover the same activity - FIFA books Club World Cup prize money outside its Development line, which made a five-to-one gap look real when it wasn't.

nodes.label: Ecuacion: display math
nodes.rationale: This is where the 'no arithmetic showmanship' rule bites: reach for it when the math reveals the business, not to perform rigor.

nodes.label: Jugada: the connection strip
nodes.rationale: Use it when the story IS a relationship; a figure-driven story should prefer Cifra clave. For la-lana it usually matches a connection also pushed to the departures board, worded the same in both places.

nodes.label: Mapa: real geography
nodes.rationale: The visual ramp is fixed: group 2 is hollow with a heavy outline, so 'everyone except X' reads as the hole in the map. Legend counts are computed from the ISO3 codes, so the count in the prose and on the map cannot disagree. CAF and AFC frames aren't pre-baked yet.

nodes.label: Reparto: the proportion bar
nodes.rationale: Not only money: any countable universe splitting into camps. Never estimate the remainder bucket - it is total minus everything you can actually source.

nodes.label: Resultados: the statement panel
nodes.rationale: Added 2026-08-11 on publisher feedback; it is the shape the collection was missing for earnings releases and filings, which Recibo, Cotizacion, Salto and Duelo each fail differently. The delta is optional per row on purpose, and the prose must not recite the grid the panel already prints.

nodes.label: Serie: two lines on one axis
nodes.rationale: For volatility, the one thing no single-moment device can show. Red is deliberately unavailable because it means 'a loss' everywhere else and would read as a permanent verdict. The 'every device number must be in the piece' rule bends here and only here: name the source and state the extremes, let interior points live on the chart.
nodes.norm_label: serie: two lines on one axis
